summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that Mauricio Augusto Silveira de Medeiros resigned as a Board member appointed by the Brazilian Federal Government, holder of the Golden Share, effective September 1, 2026. Per Article 29, item V of the Bylaws, alternate board member Walcyr Josue de Castilho Araujo assumes the seat until the next Annual Shareholders' Meeting. No terms, advisor or board recommendation stated. Watch governance implications tied to the state-appointed Golden Share seat ahead of the next AGM.
